tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the Energy North guides (electrical safety, EICR, landlords, consumer units, EV chargers, business premises). Returns titles, links and a short summary.

query.description: What the person wants to know, in plain words, e.g. "EICR for a rented flat" or "EV charger on a terraced house".

journal.description: all (default), main (electrical guides) or ev (EV charger guides).

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read the full text of one Energy North guide by its link.

tools.name: latest_guides
tools.description: List the newest guides, newest first.

tools.name: find_tradespeople
tools.description: Find verified local tradespeople in the UK on Energy North (electricians, plumbers, gas engineers, roofers, builders, cleaners and 80+ trades). Give the trade and the town or city; returns the Energy North page for that trade and place, the services covered, and the link to post a job.

trade.description: The trade or job in plain words, e.g. "electrician", "boiler repair", "roofer", "EV charger".

city.description: UK town or city, e.g. "London", "Newcastle upon Tyne", "Leeds". Leave empty for all of the UK.

tools.name: post_a_job
tools.description: Prepare a job for the person to post on Energy North: returns a link that opens the Energy North post-a-job form already filled with the trade, postcode and job details, so local verified tradespeople can reply. The person checks the details and posts it themselves; nothing is posted by this tool.

postcode.description: UK postcode of the job, if known, e.g. "N11 1AB".

details.description: What needs doing, in the person's words, up to 1000 characters.

tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: List every trade on Energy North (80+), with its name, slug and page link.

tools.name: booking_info
tools.description: How to book an EICR, an EV charger survey or other electrical work with Energy North, with the right links and the areas covered.
